mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.POLL_ID, p.WS_ID, p.PROJ_ID, p.SCOPE, p.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, p.QUESTION, p.STATUS, p.REG_DT, p.END_DT FROM POLLS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND p.SCOPE = 'WORKSPACE' AND p.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (p.END_DT IS NULL OR p.END_DT >= SYSDATE) ORDER BY p.REG_DT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.POLL_ID, p.WS_ID, p.PROJ_ID, p.SCOPE, p.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, p.QUESTION, p.STATUS, p.REG_DT, p.END_DT FROM POLLS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND p.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND p.SCOPE = 'PROJECT' AND p.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (p.END_DT IS NULL OR p.END_DT >= SYSDATE) ORDER BY p.REG_DT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT o.OPTION_ID, o.TEXT, o.OPTION_TYPE, o.IMAGE_PATH, COUNT(v.VOTE_ID) AS COUNT FROM POLL_OPTIONS o LEFT JOIN VOTES v ON o.OPTION_ID = v.OPTION_ID WHERE o.POLL_ID = #{pollId} GROUP BY o.OPTION_ID, o.TEXT, o.OPTION_TYPE, o.IMAGE_PATH ORDER BY o.OPTION_ID

SELECT p.POLL_ID, p.WS_ID, p.PROJ_ID, p.SCOPE, p.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, p.QUESTION, p.STATUS, p.REG_DT, p.END_DT FROM POLLS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.POLL_ID = #{pollId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VOTES ( VOTE_ID, POLL_ID, OPTION_ID, USER_ID ) VALUES ( SEQ_VOTE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{pollId}, #{optionId}, #{userId} )

SELECT SEQ_POLL_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO POLLS ( POLL_ID, WS_ID, PROJ_ID, SCOPE, USER_ID, QUESTION, STATUS, REG_DT , END_DT ) VALUES ( #{pollId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{scope, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{question, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE
, TO_DATE(#{endDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
)

INSERT INTO POLL_OPTIONS ( OPTION_ID, POLL_ID, TEXT, OPTION_TYPE, IMAGE_PATH ) VALUES ( SEQ_POLL_OPT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{pollId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{text, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{optionType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{imagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.POLL_ID, p.WS_ID, p.PROJ_ID, p.SCOPE, p.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, p.QUESTION, p.STATUS, p.REG_DT, p.END_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OPTION_ID) AS OPTION_COUNT, COUNT(v.VOTE_ID) AS VOTE_COUNT FROM POLLS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN POLL_OPTIONS o ON p.POLL_ID = o.POLL_ID LEFT JOIN VOTES v ON o.OPTION_ID = v.OPTION_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND p.SCOPE = 'WORKSPACE' GROUP BY p.POLL_ID, p.WS_ID, p.PROJ_ID, p.SCOPE, p.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME, p.QUESTION, p.STATUS, p.REG_DT, p.END_DT ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.REG_DT DESC

SELECT p.POLL_ID, p.WS_ID, p.PROJ_ID, p.SCOPE, p.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, p.QUESTION, p.STATUS, p.REG_DT, p.END_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OPTION_ID) AS OPTION_COUNT, COUNT(v.VOTE_ID) AS VOTE_COUNT FROM POLLS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN POLL_OPTIONS o ON p.POLL_ID = o.POLL_ID LEFT JOIN VOTES v ON o.OPTION_ID = v.OPTION_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND p.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND p.SCOPE = 'PROJECT' GROUP BY p.POLL_ID, p.WS_ID, p.PROJ_ID, p.SCOPE, p.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME, p.QUESTION, p.STATUS, p.REG_DT, p.END_DT ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.REG_DT DESC
